spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker has transiently moved the Uniswap spot price (tradePrice) to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

oracle_used_by_flows.meaning: buyback and liquidity manager operations rely on UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice as their slippage guard

guard_passes_manipulated.meaning: the slippage guard passes for the attacker-manipulated tradePrice, reporting the manipulated price as within slippage limits

claims.scope: UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice TWAP/slippage check used by buyback and liquidity operations

preconditions.text: An attacker transiently moves the Uniswap spot price (tradePrice) to an attacker-controlled level before the swap.; Buybacks and liquidity manager operations rely on UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice for their slippage guard.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The TWAP-based slippage guard should reject trades whose price deviates from the historical time-weighted average beyond the slippage bound, rather than accepting the current spot price.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The slippage guard passes for the attacker-manipulated tradePrice, so the oracle reports the manipulated price as within slippage limits.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked by buyback/liquidity manager operations as their slippage guard.
The attacker's spot-price move occurs before the guarded swap is checked.

limitations: Only the guard_passes_manipulated impact is formalized; downstream swap execution, reserve drain and economic loss are separate passes.
The TWAP-vs-spot deviation relation is captured qualitatively via the guard-pass Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.
